`pnpm test -- <file>` forwards a literal '--' to vitest, so it runs the whole suite (15 files, 681 tests), not only the named file. The Done-when still passes, but a sibling unit's failing test would fail this unit's command. The focused check is `npx vitest run tests/api/preferenceRoutes.test.ts`. package.json is outside this unit's files, so the fix belongs to the owner of package.json.

Verified in server/services/preferenceService.ts: createPreferenceService({ prisma }).get() returns focusCompanyId null when the stored focus is archived or deleted, and does not rewrite the preference row. Home can use that value and apply its own fallback for owner mode.
